executiveSummary.details: Read-only forensic verification confirms that BLOCK 130 successfully and strictly implemented LU-P5-01 (Canonical Cache Hydration). OfflineCacheService master-data hydration now reads exclusively from canonical domain repositories (projectRepository, carrierRepository, materialRepository, truckRepository, driverRepository, pricingRuleRepository). Legacy dependencies (adminConsoleService, pricingService) have been completely eliminated from offlineCache.service.ts. Block 103B deletion-aware reconciliation (reconcileStore) is strictly preserved. The authoritative BLOCK 129 Gap Register is restored and corrected: GAP-P5-01 is CLOSED; GAP-P5-02, GAP-P5-03, and GAP-P5-04 remain OPEN. Erroneous gap renumbering and premature closure claims from the initial report have been eliminated. Phase 5 remains IN PROGRESS.

projectIdSupplied.projectScoping: projectRepository.findById(projectId) isolates hydration to the specified project
projectIdSupplied.subEntityScoping: All sub-entities (carriers, materials, trucks, drivers, pricingRules) queried strictly via listByProject(projectId)

projectIdOmitted.priorSemantics: Prior adminConsoleService.getProjects() loaded all in-memory projects, and getCarriers() with no arg returned all carriers globally
projectIdOmitted.currentSemantics: projectRepository.listAll() fetches all authorized projects, followed by per-project subcollection queries for each targetProjectId
projectIdOmitted.scopePreservation: Preserves prior global hydration capability while adapting to canonical subcollection hierarchy (/projects/{projectId}/*)
projectIdOmitted.unintendedBroadening: NO - projectId remains optional for full-roster initialization, scoped strictly to user's authorized projects

activeInactiveFiltering.storageLayer: All entities stored with explicit status field in IndexedDB ('ACTIVE' | 'INACTIVE')
activeInactiveFiltering.operationalQueryLayer: Selectors getProjects, getCarriers, getMaterials, getTrucks, getDrivers, getPricingRules filter status === 'ACTIVE'
activeInactiveFiltering.validationLayer: validateOfflineTripPrerequisites verifies every entity reference is ACTIVE prior to offline queueing
